image_description: A wide-angle shot of a live concert performance on an elevated stage. The stage is crowded with musicians and equipment, illuminated by intense purple and green stage lighting beams radiating from above. A large crowd of silhouetted audience members fills the foreground. The background features a complex lighting rig and what appears to be a backdrop or screen.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elevated rectangular platform, raised slightly above floor level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The performers are clearly standing on a surface elevated above the heads of the audience in the foreground, confirming the 'elevated' nature. The horizontal line of the stage edge is visible across the mid-ground.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dimensions vary from small intimate platforms to large theatrical stages spanning the full width of a performance hall.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The stage spans the entire width of the image frame and accommodates a large band, fitting the description of a large theatrical/concert stage.
There is a distinct horizontal boundary separating the lit stage area from the dark audience silhouette, acting as the proscenium line.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface is covered with matte black flooring or painted wood.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The stage floor is heavily obscured by the legs of the performers, instruments, monitors, and intense colored lighting reflections. It is impossible to definitively identify the material or base color.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Steps or ramps provide access from floor level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Access points (stairs/ramps) are typically located at the sides or rear, which are either out of frame or occluded by the crowd and equipment. None are visible in this frontal view.
Multiple bright light sources and structural trusses are visible in the upper portion of the image, emitting the characteristic beams of a concert lighting rig.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Constructed from wood or metal decking.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Similar to the flooring checkpoint, the construction material of the deck itself is not visible due to occlusion and lighting effects.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Surface shows scuff marks from performances.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Resolution and lighting conditions make it impossible to discern fine surface details like scuff marks.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Side and rear may have wings or backdrop supports.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Vertical structures and what appears to be a backdrop or screen are visible behind the performers, consistent with stage wings/supports.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The audience members in the foreground lack individual definition and appear as a somewhat 'mushy' or fused mass of shapes rather than distinct heads/shoulders, typical of AI struggling with high-density crowds.

Upon close inspection, the interaction between the musicians' hands and their instruments (guitars/keyboards) is vague. Fingers appear fused with the instrument necks or missing entirely, lacking clear anatomical separation.
The light beams exhibit slight inconsistencies in vanishing points and opacity, appearing somewhat solid rather than volumetric, though this is common in both real photography and AI generation.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the scene is correctly classified as a 'stage' and not just a generic concert photo or other venue type.
To audit the structural integrity of the human figures (limbs/posture) amidst the complex lighting and occlusion.
To verify the spatial separation between the elevated stage and the foreground crowd, ensuring no geometric bleeding.
To assess the quality of the lighting effects and detect any subtle texture anomalies in the crowd or background.

focus_areas: Spatial separation between stage and crowd
Texture consistency in the audience silhouette
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'animal_pose_auditor' results for the musicians. AI often fails at rendering hands holding objects under complex lighting. If keypoints are low confidence, check visually for fused fingers or missing limbs.
